text.text_excerpt: Boiled crawfish! $3.99 per pound (market price and they aren't in season in August) and spicy spicy. The place has steady traffic--mostly with people grabbing food to go--but there are 2 tables where you can stay and eat. It's a no frills, rough around the edges place. Just piles of crawfish to eat on trays, with the shells going into plastic bags. There's also other food here, but seems like most people come for the crawfish. The staff is not overly friendly, but they are actually really nice and came by and talked to us about crawfish while we were eating. I don't know much about crawfish, but we had a pretty good time. Would definitely come back when the crawfish are in season.

I found out about this awesome seafood shop from a few friends! They usually rave about the Hot Sausage or Fried Shrimp Po Boys, so I just had to check them out. It's a small corner store on S Broad and you will have to find street parking around the area, but it is definitely worth it! When you walk in, there are two tables on the left side, a register in the middle, and a line of glass door fridges with beverages on the right. When it came to order, the lady was really friendly and treated everyone with utmost respect! I really feel like it's hard to mess up a Hot Sausage Po Boy, so I opted for their Fried Shrimp Po Boy for my first visit. I wanted to see how they made their Po Boys and...

Sooooo, if you like SPICY seafood, this is the place to go. I thought Hank's seafood was spicy, but Broadview takes the cake. Now, I admit that I tried the potatoes first so that could have affected how spicy I found the crawfish to be, but I will say the crawfish still had a nice kick! The crawfish were also clean and did not have much yellow stuff like I've seen at other spots. They were cooked just right and seasoned very well. Easily top 5 crawfish in NOLA for me. The corn were slightly over cooked but not too much. They were not mushy, but I could tell that they had been boiled a minute too long. They were still seasoned and spiced really well.
